suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Converts natural-language move intent into exact legal destination constraints so the planner cannot drift to nearby cells.
Marks cells that must be covered by the chosen attack, including landing-cell shots against fast movers.
Provides one flattened list of all cells actually reached or covered by the option, simplifying exact-match validation.
Engine-computed likely landing cells reduce guesswork when deciding whether to attack current position or the future position of a fast mover.
